review_candidates.title: (Senior) C# / .NET Fullstack Engineer mit Fokus Backend - Agentic Coding (all genders) - 100 % Remote
review_candidates.description: Über uns Wir bei iits bieten unseren Kunden individuelle Softwarelösungen, da jedes Unternehmen einzigartig ist und eigene Ziele und Herausforderungen hat. Dies ermöglichen wir durch die technische Expertise unserer Teams, welche die Geschäftsprozesse der Kunden tagtäglich optimieren und eine maßgeschneiderte Digitalisierung ermöglichen. Wir haben es uns zur Mission gemacht, Visionen zum Leben zu erwecken, einzelne Anforderungen zu verstehen und innovative Software zu entwickeln. Deine Aufgaben Du schreibst Code, auf den du stolz bist, und Softwareentwicklung ist für dich mehr als das reine Abarbeiten von Tickets? Du setzt KI gezielt ein, um bessere Software zu entwickeln, und erkennst das Potenzial von Agentic Coding, ohne jedem Hype zu folgen? Dann werde unser neuer (Senior) Fullstack Engineer (all genders) mit Fokus C# / .NET . Du baust Backends im Cloud-Umfeld und bringst je nach Stärke entweder das Frontend oder die Infrastruktur mit ins Team. Die Vollzeit-Anstellung ist ab sofort , remote aus ganz Deutschland verfügbar. Dein Profil Du schreibst fließend C# und entwickelst selbstständig Backend-Applikationen im Cloud-Umfeld auf Basis von .NET, wobei du auf eine tragfähige Architektur achtest. Zusätzlich bringst du eine zweite Stärke mit: entweder im Frontend (z. B. Vue.js, React oder Angular) oder in Infrastructure / CloudOps (z. B. Terraform, Kubernetes, CI/CD). Agentic Coding ist fester Bestandteil deiner Entwicklungsarbeit. Du bist mit Tools wie Claude Code, Cursor oder GitHub Copilot vertraut und setzt sie methodisch ein, etwa mit Kontext- und Rules-Dateien, plan- oder spec-getriebenen Workflows und einem kritischen Review KI-generierter Codeänderungen. Du stellst die Qualität deiner Applikationen mit Unit-, Integrations- und E2E-Tests sicher. Du erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale im Code, hinterfragst bestehende Lösungen konstruktiv und nimmst Feedback zu deinem Code ebenso an, wie du es gibst. Du übernimmst Verantwortung, triffst technische Entscheidungen nachvollziehbar und dokumentierst sie. Du bist kommunikativ, teamfähig und hast Spaß an der Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1) und gute Englischkenntnisse. Unser typischer Tech-Stack Backend: C# mit .NET Frontend: Vue.js, React oder Angular Cloud: Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud und die Telekom Public Cloud CI/CD und Infrastruktur: GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Terraform, OpenTofu, Kubernetes und Helm Agentic Coding: Claude Code Da wir individuelle Lösungen für unsere Kunden entwickeln, unterscheidet sich der konkrete Tech-Stack von Projekt zu Projekt. Deshalb ist uns deine Offenheit für neue Technologien wichtiger als das vollständige Abhaken einer Tool-Liste. Warum wir? Unser Angebot Professionelle Softwareentwicklung & moderne Softwarearchitektur – mit Fokus auf KI-Innovation Flache Hierarchien, agile Prozesse & eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten Flexible Home-Office-Regelung & Highend-Ausstattung 30 Urlaubstage + Weihnachten, Silvester und Bildungstage frei Individuelle Fortbildungen (z. B. Paper Clubs, Sprachkurse, externe Trainings) Mobilitätsangebote (Bahncard 50, JobRad) Familienfreundliche Leistungen (z. B. KITA-Zuschuss) Wellbeing-Angebote (Yogakurse & Wellpass) Regelmäßige Team-Events, Hackathons & Community-Arbeit Noch Fragen? Dann komm sehr gern auf uns zu! Wende dich sehr gern direkt an unsere Kolleg:innen aus dem Recruiting unter recruiting@iits-consulting.de . Wir freuen uns auf dich! Kununu Worth a look! Auf Kununu bewerten Mitarbeitende Arbeitgeber. Schau gern mal vorbei und überzeug dich selbst.

We combine stability with progress, while fostering a collaborative, straightforward exchange of ideas as equals. What sets our IT team apart? review_candidates.title: Graduate software engineer
review_candidates.description: At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards. In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other. For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate. A few examples of your responsibilities Build software that matters. Take real ownership from idea to production, creating systems used by millions and evolving them into products at scale. Amplify your impact with AI. Integrate the most powerful AI tools directly into your development workflow—design, implementation, testing, and documentation—to move faster while maintaining high standards for correctness, reliability, and maintainability. Master your toolkit. Work across diverse stacks with end-to-end ownership, choosing the right technologies for each challenge. From monoliths to microservices, gRPC to REST, Kubernetes to Docker, Python to Rust—you’ll apply technologies thoughtfully, focusing on depth and purpose rather than trends. Simplify relentlessly. Question every layer of complexity. Improve architectures, pipelines, and codebases to build systems that are simpler, more scalable, and easier to maintain. What we look for Reasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter. Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar. Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent. Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English. What we offer Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field. An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too. All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work. A flexible start date and part-time options. You don't need to wait until graduation to apply. We offer flexible start dates and the possibility to begin part-time, transitioning to full-time as you complete your degree. Many Spooners joined before graduating and progressively took on greater responsibility, with arrangements that allowed them to do so without compromising their education. Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount. Typical annual salary offers range from £85,797 to £151,436 in London and from €66,065 to €107,837 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £316,052 in London or €240,330 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity. Commitment & contract Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time. Location Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland), or fully remote from eligible countries. The selection process In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process. Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject. All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here. We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times. We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form. Before you apply If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again. Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment. To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage. If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

review_candidates.title: Backend Engineer
review_candidates.description: About The Company Opus Recruitment Solutions Ltd is a leading global recruitment agency specializing in connecting top-tier talent with innovative organizations across various technology sectors. Renowned for its commitment to excellence and a client-centric approach, Opus Recruitment Solutions Ltd has built a reputation for delivering tailored staffing solutions that drive business success. With a strong focus on digital transformation, artificial intelligence, and software development, the company partners with industry leaders to facilitate their growth and technological advancement. Its dedicated teams of recruiters and industry experts work tirelessly to identify, attract, and retain the most qualified professionals, ensuring clients achieve their strategic objectives efficiently and effectively. About The Role For one of our leading clients, we are seeking a highly experienced Senior Software Engineer specializing in Ruby and AI Platform to join their AI Events team. This role offers an exciting opportunity to work at the forefront of AI-driven infrastructure development, focusing on building event-driven systems that facilitate automated AI workflows throughout the software development lifecycle. The successful candidate will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, product, and design, to develop scalable, reliable, and high-performance systems that enable seamless integration of AI features into existing platforms. This position is ideal for a technically proficient professional passionate about innovative AI solutions, with a strong background in building large-scale, high-availability systems using Ruby on Rails and related technologies. Qualifications The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding and extensive experience in Ruby and Ruby on Rails, particularly within large production monoliths. Proven expertise in designing and maintaining high-throughput, high-availability systems is essential. Candidates should have a track record of developing user-facing products that incorporate Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI agents, demonstrating the ability to create autonomous workflows that enable AI agents to perform actions independently. Strong communication skills are necessary for effective collaboration within remote, globally distributed teams. Additional experience with Python, developer tooling, or GitLab as a product will be considered advantageous. A proactive mindset, adaptability to evolving AI technologies, and the ability to solve complex technical challenges are crucial for success in this role. Responsibilities Design and develop trigger systems that connect GitLab events, such as code pushes, merge requests, issue changes, CI/CD results, and deployments, to AI-powered workflows. Create and maintain integrations for third-party tools like Jira, Jenkins, and Slack to facilitate seamless event handling and automation. Contribute to the core event platform that enables AI features to determine optimal timing and execution of workflows. Architect scalable systems ensuring high availability, reliability, and throughput to handle large volumes of events efficiently. Maintain and enhance production functionality within a substantial Ruby on Rails monolithic architecture. Propose and implement iterative solutions to complex technical challenges, influencing product and architectural decisions across multiple services. Collaborate with engineering, product, design, and AI platform teams to expand trigger capabilities and support the broader agent ecosystem. Participate in Tier 2 and Tier 3 on-call rotations, troubleshooting production issues, security concerns, and urgent engineering problems to ensure system stability and security. Benefits Our client offers a competitive benefits package that includes flexible remote working arrangements, allowing employees to work from anywhere. The role provides opportunities for professional growth and development through continuous learning initiatives, training programs, and exposure to cutting-edge AI technologies. Employees benefit from a collaborative and innovative work environment that encourages knowledge sharing and creativity. Additionally, the company offers comprehensive health and wellness benefits, paid time off, and performance-based incentives aimed at recognizing and rewarding outstanding contributions. The organization fosters a culture of diversity and inclusion, promoting equal opportunities for all employees to thrive and succeed. Equal Opportunity Our client is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment for all employees. They celebrate diversity and are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of race, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic. They believe that a diverse workforce enhances innovation and creativity, and they actively promote a culture of respect, fairness, and opportunity for everyone. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected status.
